title: Provision and Passage
author: Casper Marchetti
blurb: Elodie Galloway, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
